claims.value: 3B parameter decoder-only sparse language model with per-layer Sliding Window Attention and learnable attention sinks, trained on open source and proprietary data for general-purpose English tasks.
claims.evidence: Granite-SWASH-3B-a600M is a 3B parameter decoder-only sparse language model with **per-layer Sliding Window Attention (SWA)** and **learnable attention sinks**

claims.value: Based on a decoder-only mixture-of-experts transformer architecture with 48 experts and top K of 4, using GQA, RoPE, SwiGLU MLP, and RMSNorm.
claims.evidence: based on a decoder-only mixture-of-experts transformer architecture... MoE with shared experts... GQA, RoPE, MLP with SwiGLU, RMSNorm

claims.value: Uses a sliding window size of 128 tokens. Attention pattern includes 8 full-attention layers and 20 sliding-window layers with learnable per-head attention sinks.
claims.evidence: Sliding window size | 128 ... 8 full-attention layers ... and 20 sliding-window layers

claims.value: Requires Hugging Face Transformers library version greater than 5.8.0 for usage.
Flashed Attention 3 and 4 are recommended for speed as they natively incorporate LSE scaling. Eager attention is a fallback. SDPA is not a supported backend.
claims.evidence: Flash Attention 3 and 4 with native LSE (recommended for speed)... SDPA does not express sink tokens or `sink_scale`, and so is not a supported backend
